name: Teriyaki Chicken Wings with Veggie Sticks & Ranch Dip

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 260°C (500°F) and position rack in the centre. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the chicken wings on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat. Spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.362 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through cooking time, until cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare the ranch dip by mixing together lemon juice, mayo, onion powder, garlic powder, dill, salt, and pepper. Place in the fridge to chill.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemon
1 cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp dill
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the carrots, celery, and cucumber. Peel carrots, trim ends, and cut into sticks. Trim ends and cut celery into sticks. Cut cucumber into sticks.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium carrots
9 sticks celery
1 ½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger.

In a small saucepan, prepare the teriyaki sauce by combining water, soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic powder. Bring to a boil and allow to boil until the mixture has reduced and thickened, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup water
18 tbsp soy sauce
6 tbsp honey
3 tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the wings are cooked, transfer them to a bowl and pour the teriyaki sauce over top; toss to coat.
Serve wings with veggie sticks and ranch dip. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
